source_areas.description: Public Flyto2 distribution model, product catalog, historical release continuity, and source ownership routing.
Machine-readable versioning, release evidence, SBOM/provenance, signing, and release-manifest contracts.
Security disclosure and durable project memory for the distribution/source-authority boundary.
Distribution-contract checks, deterministic metadata bundling, and strict repository verification.

feature_surfaces.title: Product registry
feature_surfaces.description: Binds installable Flyto2 product identities to source repositories and distribution tag namespaces.

feature_surfaces.title: Release governance
feature_surfaces.description: Defines immutable product versions, required release evidence, channels, and artifact-storage boundaries.

feature_surfaces.title: Historical Flyto2 Flow lineage
feature_surfaces.description: Preserves root v0.x releases as the pre-rename Flyto2 Flow lineage without rewriting historical tags or assets.

feature_surfaces.title: Security disclosure routing
feature_surfaces.description: Provides the private Flyto2 disclosure channel for distribution and historical artifacts.

feature_surfaces.title: Source authority boundary
feature_surfaces.description: Keeps product implementation in product repositories while flyto2 owns official distribution metadata and promotion.
